notes: Token: src/IMDOLAR.sol, contract IMDOLAR, an OpenZeppelin ERC20 named IMDOLAR with symbol DOLAR and 18 decimals. The constructor mints INITIAL_SUPPLY = 1_000_000_000 * 10^18 = 1000000000000000000000000000 minor units exactly once to msg.sender, which is the factory under launchCustom; token.totalSupply states that figure. The sole constructor argument is address poolManager_, resolved from the $poolManager placeholder to the chain's Uniswap v4 PoolManager and stored as an immutable. The constructor reverts with InvalidPoolManager if that address is zero, equals msg.sender, equals the token itself, or has no code, so the launch cannot deploy against a misconfigured manager. The contracts array is empty: the accepted tree holds only the token, with no application contracts and no initialization calls. Tax rule (the 99% buy tax, no exceptions): _update is overridden so that every non-zero transfer whose source is the PoolManager, including transferFrom, burns amount - floor(amount / 100) to address(0) and delivers floor(amount / 100) to the recipient. There are no caller or recipient exemptions, no owner, no tax setter, no mint path after the constructor, and no pause, blacklist, freeze or seize function. Rounding is against the buyer: a buy below 100 minor units burns entirely. Because the rule keys on the source address, any ERC-20 outflow from the manager is taxed the same way, including liquidity withdrawals; a swap whose output stays inside the manager as an ERC-6909 claim is taxed only when later withdrawn as a transfer. Buys on other venues are outside this definition, since an ERC-20 cannot identify an arbitrary purchase without a v4 hook, which this token does not supply. All launch flows move exactly their stated amounts: the factory's transfer of the swarm's share to the MerkleDistributor, distributor claims, the single-sided pool seed from the factory into the manager, the remainder forwarded to economics.remainderTo, and sells from a trader into the manager are all sourced from addresses other than the manager and are untaxed. Burns are the only post-launch supply change and can only shrink it. Pool: pairedCurrency is the chain's pair token named by the request, fee 3000 (0.3%), tickSpacing 60. initialPrice is provenance only. It is floor(sqrt(initialMarketCapWei * 2^192 / totalSupply)) = 127997013751724836065202479, the sqrtPriceX96 with DOLAR as currency0 and the pair token as currency1; if the deployed token address sorts above the pair token the inverse ordering applies and the deployer derives the actual opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and totalSupply. economics is the requester's object copied verbatim; the swarm's 1000 bps is taken by the factory and is not written here.
